description.value: The Prestige Beach House Kelowna is a contemporary lakeside hotel situated steps from Hot Sands Beach and directly across from City Park on Okanagan Lake, with easy walking access to downtown Kelowna. Part of a family-owned BC collection of 19 properties, it sits close to the Myra Canyon trestle cycling route and Okanagan waterfront paths that touring cyclists frequent. Guests have access to an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, and an on-site restaurant.
